title: Diadroids World - Evil Teikoku no Yabou (Japan)

fields.name: payload_region_1_zero
fields.evidence: Logical 0x000..0x10B all zero in block-reversed RAM image; no function in decompiled.c writes these offsets

fields.name: ff_padding_field
fields.evidence: Logical 0x10C..0x12B = 32x 0xFF; PACKET candidate spans 0x10C/0x128 are this field's edges, not checksums

fields.name: counter_at_0x180
fields.evidence: Logical bytes 01 00 00 00 at 0x180 in RAM image

fields.name: record_array_4x28
fields.evidence: Writer pattern decompiled.c:1889-1925 (base+0x1B4+i*0x1C) matches logical 0x1B4..0x223 values exactly; base-pointer identity with save mirror is HYPOTHESIS (literal values absent)

fields.name: zero_padding_pre_trailer
fields.evidence: Logical 0x224..0x227 zero; 0x224 is also FUN_0803c974 payload-size constant

fields.name: magic_DIABLK_logical
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c9b8 writes 0x44 0x49 0x41 0x42 0x4C 0x4B; FUN_0803ca54 compares D,I,A,B,L,K; block-reversed raw sav shows KLBAID at predicted offsets in both copies

fields.name: checksum_sum8_u16
fields.evidence: Python: sum(ram[:0x228])&0xFFFF == 0x2C0A == stored u16_le in both copies of cap-01
